policy.source_selection: Known-unused project speaker identities from fixed public train360 first8 shards; source plan frozen before neural inference. External pretraining overlap unknown. Backgrounds are project-consumed, licensed and canonical-speaker disjoint.
policy.source_extent: First128000 mono16kHz s16 source samples (0–8s), duration eligibility only; no response-based source choice.
policy.normalization: Unmarked foreground float32 at RMS0.1; add native full-clip public mark, fixed alternating16bit message. Partial only copies marked source samples32000:96000; rest bit-identical.
policy.background: Four matched0dB backgrounds per speaker: deterministic white noise and exact licensed environmental/music/other-speech excerpts. Gain uses the unmarked foreground RMS, identical for every mark state.
policy.gain: One float32 peak-safe gain shared across every mark state and condition for a speaker; min(1,0.8/max absolute pre-codec sample). No hidden clipping.
policy.codec: 64kbps seekable MP3 of each clean gained state, decoded mono16kHz float32 with exact sample-count requirement; no alignment trimming or padding.
policy.readout: Frozen v1 native strict sample>0.5; quarter-second bin selected only when more than half its samples exceed0.5. Every native sample and bin retained.
policy.reporting: Per-condition unmarked false responses, full/partial misses, selected interval IoU/coverage/outside time; same32 speakers repeated, not576 independent sources. Fixed Wilson95 intervals for file rates.
policy.scope: Public-family localization and robustness only. Deliberately marked real speech is not AI-generated speech.
